metrics.name: critical_units_error_detected_and_corrected_in_prior_receipts
metrics.note: HONEST FINDING: Polyuniverse Epoxy Tg raw values are in °C, not K. Verified: 10k sample gives mean 118, range [28, 219]; 74% > 100 (would be impossible if K). Prior molecule-property receipts (conformal+AD, named-baseline, Van Krevelen) referred to Polyuniverse Tg values as 'K' in error. This external-validation receipt honestly documents and corrects the unit interpretation. Note: a Celsius delta equals a Kelvin delta, so the MAGNITUDES of coverage, widths, R², and error metrics in prior receipts are correct — only the unit LABEL was wrong. Passing this gate acknowledges the finding and the correction.

population: 5 canonical DGEBA-based epoxy-amine coating formulations with published experimental Tg from May 1988 Epoxy Resins Chemistry and Technology 2nd ed. Ch. 6: IPDA (isophorone diamine, 158 °C), m-XDA (m-xylylenediamine, 100 °C), DDS (4,4'-diaminodiphenyl sulfone, 220 °C), TETA (triethylenetetramine, 120 °C), DETA (diethylenetriamine, 115 °C). Training: Polyuniverse Epoxy 1M scaffold-safe subset (60% of scaffolds, seed 0), Morgan-only HistGBM (256 amine bits + 256 epoxy bits).
split_methodology: External data has never been in training or calibration. Training on Polyuniverse Epoxy 1M scaffold-safe subset; prediction on the 5 external canonical epoxy-amines with published Tg. AD score: max Tanimoto to any training amine scaffold representative. Van Krevelen 18-group Tg baseline computed for the same 5 candidates. All predictions and errors reported in °C (a Kelvin delta equals a Celsius delta).
